en: Colorized panoramic postcard view of a spa town set against a forested hillside and distant mountains. The foreground and midground show dense blocks of grand, white and light‑colored historic buildings with ornate facades, mansard roofs, towers and domes, characteristic of a 19th‑century Central European resort. The image has printed captions at the top identifying the place.
